description: This file implements a Fraud Scoring Engine for an Insurance Fraud Detection Platform. It includes functions to evaluate claims against multiple fraud detection rules, resolve evaluators dynamically, compute a fraud score, and persist signals and results to a database. The file contains multiple rule evaluation functions, evaluator resolution logic, and core API functions for scoring and saving claim evaluations.

methods.name: Tuple[bool,str] _evaluate_high_amount(claim: Dict[str, Any], config: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Checks if claim amount exceeds a configurable threshold.

methods.name: Tuple[bool,str] _evaluate_quick_filing(claim: Dict[str, Any], config: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Checks if claim was filed suspiciously soon after the incident.

methods.name: Tuple[bool,str] _evaluate_frequency(claim: Dict[str, Any], config: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Checks if policyholder has multiple claims within a specified time window.

methods.name: Tuple[bool,str] _evaluate_no_police_report(claim: Dict[str, Any], config: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Flags claims above a dollar amount lacking a police report.

methods.name: Tuple[bool,str] _evaluate_no_witnesses(claim: Dict[str, Any], config: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Flags high-value claims with zero witnesses.

methods.name: Tuple[bool,str] _evaluate_location(claim: Dict[str, Any], config: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Checks for suspicious location patterns using keyword matching.

methods.name: Tuple[bool,str] _evaluate_network(claim: Dict[str, Any], config: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Checks if claim's policyholder is linked to a known fraud network.

methods.name: Tuple[bool,str] _evaluate_duplicate_claimant(claim: Dict[str, Any], config: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Detects if the same claimant name appears on multiple recent claims.

methods.name: Tuple[bool,str] _evaluate_suspicious_description(claim: Dict[str, Any], config: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Flags claims whose description contains suspicious keywords.

methods.name: Tuple[bool,str] _evaluate_third_party_involvement(claim: Dict[str, Any], config: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Flags claims involving third parties, indicating organized fraud.

methods.name: Tuple[bool,str] _evaluate_recent_policy(claim: Dict[str, Any], config: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Flags claims filed shortly after policy start date by checking policy start.

methods.name: Tuple[bool,str] _evaluate_address_match(claim: Dict[str, Any], config: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Detects if the same claimant address appears on multiple claims.

methods.name: Tuple[int,List[Dict[str,Any]]] evaluate_claim(claim: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Evaluates a claim against all active fraud rules and computes a fraud score.

methods.name: None save_signals(claim_id: str, signals: List[Dict[str, Any]])
methods.description: Persists fraud signal evaluations to the database for a given claim.

methods.name: Tuple[int,List[Dict[str,Any]]] score_and_save( claim_id: str, claim_data: Dict[str, Any] )
methods.description: Evaluates claim, saves signals, and updates the claim's fraud score and status.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,str]] get_available_evaluators()
methods.description: Returns a list of all named evaluator keys with descriptions for UI purposes.
